title: Implement Static 32 GB Set-VMMemory Command Builder
instructions: Create the file: this chunk owns the module docstring, imports and constants. Satisfy SRS-412-02-FR-001: The Quarantine VM shall enforce a static 32 GB RAM ceiling with Hyper-V Dynamic Memory permanently disabled. Host side, runs on Windows. Reuse get_vm_ram_cap_bytes() from src/cochem/warden/memory_cap.py (34359738368 bytes) instead of a second constant. Build an argv list for powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command Set-VMMemory -VMName <name> -DynamicMemoryEnabled $false -StartupBytes <cap>; never shell=True, and quote the VM name. The VM must be Off to change memory: refuse with a clear error otherwise. Traceability test: test_f05_srs_covers_all_core_domains_vm_warden_db_tdd (tests/test_stage1_srs_dag.py).
